items.q: What are check-in and check-out times?
items.a:
Check-in: 16:00–20:00. If arriving after 20:00, please let us know in advance.
Check-out: 08:00–11:00.

Luggage storage is available for early arrivals or late departures.
Reception is open 08:00–20:00 daily. Please contact us if you plan to arrive or depart outside these hours.

items.q: Is there a shuttle to the airport?
items.a: We can arrange a taxi shuttle to or from Nice airport or the train stations. The cost to Nice airport is approximately €60. Reception will be happy to book for you.

Le Restaurant: dinner 19:00–22:00, open year-round (closed Tuesdays in low season).

La Guinguette: lunch 12:00–15:00, mid-April to mid-October.
Breakfast is not included by default (except in special offers). Served 08:00–10:30. See breakfast details.

items.q: Can I bring outside food or beverages?
items.a: We kindly request that no outside food, beverages, or groceries be consumed in guest rooms or common areas. Each suite features a curated minibar with full bottles of wine, local provisions, and artisanal selections.
We offer an extensive in-suite minibar with snacks, provisions, and drinks rather than traditional room service.

items.q: Can three people stay in a double suite?
items.a: Select suite categories (Bronzette, Mas de l'Artiste, Bon-Vivant, Pénéquet) can accommodate an extra bed at €80/night. Standard suites are strictly for two guests.

items.q: Is there a safe in the suites?
items.a: All suites have an electronic safe with a personal numerical code.
